caption: Figure 1: Left: The attention mechanism a ( W ⃗ h i , W ⃗ h j ) employed by our model, parametrized by a weight vector ⃗ a ∈ R 2 F ′ , applying a LeakyReLU activation. Right: An illustration of multihead attention (with K = 3 heads) by node 1 on its neighborhood. Different arrow styles and colors denote independent attention computations. The aggregated features from each head are concatenated or averaged to obtain ⃗ h ′ 1 .
description:
## Description
This figure illustrates the attention mechanism and multihead attention in Graph Attention Networks (GAT). The left panel shows the attention mechanism, where a weight vector is applied to node features to compute attention scores. The right panel depicts multihead attention with three heads, where each head computes independent attention scores and the results are aggregated.
